# glpi_infocom (Resource)

GLPI financial record of an item: purchase, warranty and depreciation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "glpi_computer" "db" {
  name = "db-01"
}

resource "glpi_infocom" "db" {
  item_type = "Computer"
  item_id   = glpi_computer.db.id
  buy_date  = "2026-01-15"
  value     = 4917000
  sink_time = 5
  sink_type = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `item_id` (Number) ID of the item the information belongs to.
- `item_type` (String) GLPI itemtype the information belongs to, for example Computer or Rack.

### Optional

- `bill` (String) Invoice number.
- `buy_date` (String) Purchase date as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `comment` (String) Free-form comment.
- `delivery_number` (String) Delivery number.
- `entity_id` (Number) ID of the entity that owns the item. 0 is the root entity.
- `immo_number` (String) Asset number in the accounting system.
- `order_number` (String) Order number.
- `sink_coefficient` (Number) Degressive depreciation coefficient.
- `sink_time` (Number) Depreciation period in years.
- `sink_type` (Number) Depreciation method as GLPI numbers it: 0 none, 2 linear, 3 degressive.
- `use_date` (String) Date the item entered service as YYYY-MM-DD.
- `value` (Number) Purchase value.
- `warranty_duration` (Number) Warranty duration in months.
- `warranty_value` (Number) Warranty value.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) GLPI numeric ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by GLPI numeric ID.
terraform import glpi_infocom.example 42
```
